9️⃣ MiniSudoku

A 9x9 grid divided into 3x3 boxes — fill each cell with a digit from 1 to 9, ensuring no digit repeats in any row, column, or box. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Fill each cell with a number from 1 to 9.
  2. No number can repeat in any row, column, or 3x3 box.
  3. Scan rows, columns, and boxes for cells that can only hold one number.
  4. Use pencil marks to note possible values for difficult cells.
  5. Complete the entire grid correctly to win.
